name: 微信通道
description: 微信扫码登录（与腾讯 openclaw-weixin 同源的 ilink 协议）：出站长轮询收消息，微信里直接指挥 agent，无需公网 IP / 开端口。
descriptionEn: WeChat channel (ilink protocol, same origin as Tencent openclaw-weixin): outbound long-polling, drive the agent from WeChat, no public IP needed.

contextmenu.project.label: 设为微信通道根目录
contextmenu.project.hint: 把该项目设为微信通道执行指令的工作空间根目录
contextmenu.project.hintEn: Use this project as the workspace root for WeChat channel commands

settings.label: 允许的用户
settings.hint: 微信用户 ID，逗号分隔；* = 全部放行。空 = 新用户需在视图里手动配对
settings.hintEn: WeChat user IDs, comma-separated; * = allow all. Empty = new users must be paired manually in the view

settings.label: 自动执行指令
settings.hint: 已配对用户的微信消息自动投给 agent（关 = 只收不执行，视图里手动转）
settings.hintEn: Messages from paired users go to the agent automatically (off = receive only, forward manually in the view)

settings.label: 响应群聊
settings.hint: 默认只回私聊，群消息直接忽略
settings.hintEn: Off = reply to direct messages only; group chat messages are ignored

settings.label: 默认工作空间
settings.hint: agent 执行微信指令的工作目录；空 = 伪客户端当前目录（首次为宿主启动目录）。Windows 下禁止填系统目录（如 System32）
settings.hintEn: Working directory for WeChat commands; empty = follow the pseudo-client cwd (host startup directory first). System directories are rejected on Windows (e.g. System32)

settings.label: 模型
settings.hint: 下拉选已配置鉴权的模型；空 = 跟随全局默认模型（候选清单随模型配置自动刷新）
settings.hintEn: Pick a configured model; empty = follow the global default model (options refresh with the model config)

settings.label: 思考强度
settings.hint: 下拉选档位（off…max）；空 = 跟随全局设置
settings.hintEn: Pick a level (off…max); empty = follow the global setting

settings.label: 投递到网页当前会话
settings.labelEn: Deliver to the open web conversation
settings.hint: 开 = 微信指令直接 steer 到浏览器正在打开的对话（网页实时可见）；关或无打开对话时走独立无头会话
settings.hintEn: On = steer WeChat commands into the conversation open in the browser (visible live); off or no open conversation = isolated headless session

settings.label: 执行超时提醒(秒)
settings.hint: agent 跑超此时长先回一条“还在执行”，出结果再追一条
settings.hintEn: If the agent runs longer than this, reply "still working" first, then follow up with the result

settings.label: 正在输入提示
settings.hint: 开 = 发送消息前先显示正在输入；关 = 直接发送
settings.hintEn: On = show a typing indicator before sending; off = send directly

settings.label: 接收图片/文件落地
settings.hint: 微信发来的图片/文件下载解密后存到工作区 .pi-wechat-media/，AI 可直接读取；关 = 只收占位文字（省流量）
settings.hintEn: Images/files from WeChat are decrypted into workspace .pi-wechat-media/ for the AI to read directly; off = placeholder text only (saves bandwidth)

settings.label: 给 AI 发微信工具
settings.hint: 注册 wechat_send，agent 可主动发微信文本/图片/文件
settings.hintEn: Register wechat_send so the agent can proactively send WeChat text/images/files
